content: Mushroom-farm management software (Gros.farm, Mycro, MycoHub, Fancom) centers on: batch/flush lifecycle tracking (spawn to flush, colonization/fruiting timelines, multi-harvest per batch), substrate/compost lot tracking with phase and climate context, contamination-early-catch workflows, and real-time temp/humidity/CO2 sensor dashboards feeding climate control. Flush-cycle and substrate-lot tracking is treated as a core, differentiating capability distinct from generic greenhouse dashboards.
